description: Deterministic Finance Ops 3-way match engine for wholesalers and Shopify merchants. Cross-examines approved Purchase Order lines, warehouse dock receiving counts (good vs damaged units), and billed supplier invoice lines to catch silent unit-price creep, short-shipments billed in full, unapproved surcharges, and freight cap overages. Emits ready-to-import QuickBooks Online (`quickbooks_bill_csv`) and Xero (`xero_bill_csv`) Purchase Bill CSVs containing ONLY verified payable quantities and unit costs, plus a vendor Debit Memo email. Free Local Sandbox audits up to 15 invoice lines per call; Pro/License unlocks unlimited invoice audits.

agreed_freight_cap_usd.description: Maximum freight/shipping charge agreed on the PO, if applicable.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for QuickBooks/Xero export.

demo_mode.description: Run a realistic 3-way match audit catching silent price creep, damaged units, and unapproved pallet fees.

due_date.description: Bill due date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to Net 30 from invoice_date).

invoice_date.description: Invoice date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today UTC).

invoice_extra_fees_usd.description: Freight, pallet, or handling charges billed on the invoice.

invoice_lines.description: Billed lines extracted from the supplier PDF/CSV invoice.

billed_unit_cost_usd.description: Unit price charged on the supplier invoice in USD.

sku.description: Billed SKU identifier (or fee code) on vendor invoice.

invoice_number.description: Supplier invoice number for QuickBooks/Xero Bill CSV export (defaults to INV-<po_number>).

ordered_qty.description: Quantity approved on original Purchase Order.

unit_cost_usd.description: Agreed PO unit price in USD.

qbo_expense_account.description: QuickBooks Online expense/COGS account name (defaults to 'Cost of Goods Sold').

damaged_qty.description: Damaged/defective units rejected or quarantined on arrival.

sku.description: SKU identifier scanned at warehouse dock.

xero_account_code.description: Xero chart-of-accounts code for inventory/COGS lines (defaults to '310').

name: reconcile_po_three_way_match
title: Audit PO vs Receiving vs Supplier Invoice (3-Way Match + QuickBooks/Xero CSVs)
